about: The review key (R-450). Every row Denning was shown of the engine's plays: what the engine said then (shown), his mark and his words (said), and checks: Claude's reading of his mark as things the plays must hold or must not hold, which he corrects. Scored by tools/golden/review.py on the branch after every change. Marks: right, partly, wrong, bad example (set aside), not marked. Set 1 is the 35 rows of 2026-11-13, picked one or more to a kind of play, so it is a regression test and not an accuracy figure; whole-game sets (R-454) give the accuracy by kind of play. `answered` holds a later answer of his on a row (what was asked, his words, Claude's reading).

rows.shown: Book's Hammer solo by the back door, nobody defending | Not met: no NPC taken
rows.said: We need to clean this up a bit to see when the split actually reaches base/NPCs/etc, and also the defense. Hammer only reaches near pit at 19:17, is defended by a rit at 19:28; and then they resign at 19:44. I think we also need to clean up when flags and splits happen, I know we can see retroactive moves (and that is a good approach) but I think when I was previously reviewing the golden moments there was identification of players going to flag/split much earlier than I ever would have called it.

checks.why: Book v One: the Hammer dies at 19:31 with One's Ritualist within reach of him for 8 s, and the game ends 12 s later, so the game-end rule of R-459 (built) does not reach this row; a defender on a split player for under 12 s when that player dies is still not read as a phase. To put to him

answered.asked: Does a defender still on the split when the game ends count, though under 12 s there?
answered.reading: R-459; the open check stays open until it is built.

rows.shown: Dz's three against OG's three | Not met: two footmen and an archer lost
rows.said: Fight is too messy to call this a 3v3 but it has raised two points. When defending on split, you just need to protect PIT NPCs. When attacking on split, taking footies/archers counts as an NPC take. Also, for these results on split, we are just measuring the actual split impact. So if a player or footies dies elsewhere on the map not related to the split, the split shouldn't get credit for that.
